source: System of record and synchronization taken from repository code (2026-11-22). Owner, classification, retention and correction/deletion workflow are recorded only where a source states them; null means an owner decision is still required (organization docs/architecture/ECOSYSTEM_ARCHITECTURE.md section 4).

domains.title: Employee and workforce records
domains.synchronization: none: not copied to other projects

domains.title: Accounts payable, receivable and payables records
domains.synchronization: none: not copied to other projects

domains.title: Ingested ecosystem audit events
domains.synchronization: asaa.event.v1 envelopes POSTed by each producer (DEP-EVENTS); producers keep their own audit store

domains.title: User and service identities
domains.synchronization: OIDC tokens issued by the realm; ASAA provisions users through the asaa-identity-sync service account (DEP-IDENTITY)

domains.title: Paired devices, sessions and approvals
domains.synchronization: none: device data stays in JARVIS

domains.title: Templates, releases and delivery ledger
domains.synchronization: none: exports and hand-offs are recorded in the Templates delivery ledger

domains.title: Portfolio profiles, media and resumes
domains.synchronization: none: each of the four profiles is isolated inside Portfolio

domains.title: Dependency, image and configuration policy records
domains.synchronization: asaa.configuration.policy-report.v1 consumed by the governance report (DEP-POLICY-GATE)

domains.title: Projects, risks, dependencies, backlog and evidence
